mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kafka_message_queue ( topic, partition_key, message_body, headers, status, retry_count ) VALUES ( #{topic}, #{partitionKey}, #{messageBody}, #{headers}, #{status}, #{retryCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic, partition_key, message_body, headers, status, retry_count, created_at, consumed_at, error_log FROM kafka_message_queue WHERE topic = #{topic} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE kafka_message_queue SET status = #{status}, error_log = #{errorLog}, retry_count = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' THEN retry_count + 1 ELSE retry_count END, consumed_at = CASE WHEN #{consumedAtSql} = 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE consumed_at END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kafka_message_queue SET status = 'PENDING', error_log = NULL, consumed_at = NULL, retry_count = 0 WHERE status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sent_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CONSUMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consumed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count FROM kafka_message_queue
